title: Selling Options On Futures For Income (NQ & ES Explained)
summary: An anonymous trader who calls herself "OS / The Option Seller" (no real name given) pitches selling 0DTE put credit spreads (and sometimes naked puts) on /NQ and /ES futures options, choosing strikes off gamma-exposure (GEX) levels rather than a fixed delta and leaning on intraday "repair" (assignment, shorting the future to cover, rolling). She claims a 91% win rate and ~$77,000 on a 100K account in only ~4 months, self-reported inside her paid Substack/Discord — an extraordinary return on the most vacuous metric (win rate on credit spreads) with a direct sales motive and no separable track record. The genuine value is her repeated, correct warning that 13.9x futures leverage will kill an oversized account; the risk is high because it is leveraged 0DTE futures with discretionary directional repair and occasional undefined-risk naked puts. Untestable on our data (futures options absent from the table; intraday + discretionary GEX would be uncapturable even if present). Write-up: strategies/futures_strangle_nq_es.md (conviction 1.5/5).
